title: The explicit global-section augmentation is a cochain map
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U_i$ any family of open subsets indexed by a type $\iota$, and $I$ an injective resolution [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of the lifted additive structure sheaf [def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction]. Write $G_I$ for its global section complex, $T_{U,I}$ for its open Cech total complex, and $\alpha_n:G_I^n\to T_{U,I}^n$ for the explicit restriction augmentation [def-pbc-etale-additive-cech-normalization]. There exists a cochain map $a:G_I\to T_{U,I}$ whose degree-$n$ component is $\alpha_n$ for every $n\geq0$. No covering, finiteness, affineness or separatedness assumption is made.

source.place: Tag 01EQ, Lemma 20.11.2, the restriction augmentation in the augmented double-complex construction; its chain-map equation, without inverting it.

proof.text: Define a_n by restriction to single opens. Project its horizontal differential to a two-entry tuple. Both summands restrict the same section to the same tuple intersection, and their signs are opposite, so the horizontal differential is zero. Naturality of the sheaf resolution differential proves vertical compatibility.

Include a_n into the (0,n) summand of the total complex. The total differential is the sum of horizontal and signed vertical differentials; the horizontal term vanishes by the previous calculation and the vertical sign in Cech degree zero is one. This gives the cochain-map equation and the required component formula. Empty families give zero maps.

theorem exists_additiveCech_alpha_map {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u}
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (I : InjectiveResolution X.etaleAdditiveSheaf) :
    ∃ a : additiveCechGlobal I ⟶ additiveCechTotal U I,
      ∀ n, a.f n = additiveCechAlpha U I n
